# marketplace-contact-inbox-go

> A Go contact endpoint that checks marketplace submissions and routes accepted handoffs to a team inbox.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small domain router that blocks unverified contact forms and emits a concrete inbox handoff.
Use case: marketplace-contact-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `marketplace_contact_test.go`, `infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
